title: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next on PipeNetwork's MLX runtime with streaming quantization
slug_note: The only MLX path that carries the Flash-Next architecture at all, with the quantization economics measured: mixed 4/8-bit costs +1.3% NLL versus +20.6% for uniform 4-bit.

variation.quant_detail: mixed 4/8-bit MLX build (106.2 GB), the repo's recommended one

engine.config: PipeNetwork runtime shipping qwen4_exp support + streaming quantization; mixed-4_8bit build recommended

requirements.notes: Mixed build is 106.2 GB on disk; the 51B n-gram tables alone would be 102 GB unquantized.

steps.text: Build the mixed-4_8bit quant with the repo's streaming quantizer
Serve through the repo's MLX runtime (stock mlx-lm cannot load qwen4_exp)

measurements.method: wikitext-2 perplexity of each build plus a coherent-generation check
measurements.note: wikitext-2 (test) perplexity of the upstream bfloat16 model, teacher-forced over 145 windows of 2048 tokens

measurements.method: wikitext-2 perplexity of each build plus a coherent-generation check
measurements.note: perplexity of the recommended mixed-4_8bit build (106.2 GB), +0.0128 NLL/token vs bf16 [95% CI +0.0109, +0.0148], 128/145 windows worse = +1.3%

measurements.method: wikitext-2 perplexity of each build plus a coherent-generation check
measurements.note: uniform 4-bit build (103.8 GB), +0.1872 NLL/token [95% CI +0.1778, +0.1968], 145/145 windows worse = +20.6% cost

measurements.method: wikitext-2 perplexity of each build plus a coherent-generation check
measurements.note: 8-bit build (192.2 GB), +0.0009 NLL/token [-0.0003, +0.0021] = statistically indistinguishable from bf16; 6-bit (148.0 GB) 4.4767, +0.0013

measurements.method: wikitext-2 perplexity of each build plus a coherent-generation check
measurements.note: on-disk size of the mixed-4_8bit build, the recommended one below 150 GB (8bit 192.2 GB, 6bit 148.0 GB, 4bit 103.8 GB, bf16 360.0 GB)

measurements.method: wikitext-2 perplexity of each build plus a coherent-generation check
measurements.note: bf16 model loaded through this runtime generating coherently, 354 GB resident (text-only runtime; the 0.4B vision tower is carried in bf16 but unused)

measurements.method: wikitext-2 perplexity of each build plus a coherent-generation check
measurements.note: size of the 51B-parameter n-gram embedding tables alone if left unquantized - the reason they get their own group-32 quantization

caveats: The +1.3% NLL penalty of the mixed build (versus +20.6% uniform 4-bit) is a ratio, not a perplexity; kept as a caveat so it is not mistaken for a score.
Perplexity rows compare builds of the same weights: 4.4708 bf16, 4.4749 8-bit, 4.5286 mixed, 5.3914 uniform 4-bit.
The builder repo tags its own license as 'other'; the weights lineage is Qwen Apache-2.0.
Builder runtimes carry their own terms on top of the weights (Mia's scripts are AGPL-3.0).
